questions.content:
Speaking — Part 1 - Personal information

Could you please introduce yourself? Tell me your name, where you are from, and what you do or study.
questions.sampleAnswer: My name is Nam and I am twenty years old. I come from Hanoi, the capital of Vietnam. Currently, I am a student at a university. I study computer science because I love technology and I want to be a programmer.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 1 - Personal information

What did you do last night? Tell me where you were, who you were with, and what you did.
questions.sampleAnswer: Last night I was at home with my family. We had a delicious dinner together and then we watched a movie on TV. I went to bed early because I was very tired after a long day at school.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 1 - Personal information

What do you usually do to relax or rest? Tell me what you do, when you do it, and why you enjoy it.
questions.sampleAnswer: To relax, I usually listen to music in my bedroom. I often do this in the evening after finishing my homework. I really enjoy it because music helps me forget my stress and makes me feel very happy.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 2 - Describe a picture

Describe the picture.
questions.sampleAnswer: In this picture, I can see two people in a bright, modern office. They are having a job interview. A man and a woman are sitting across a wooden desk. The woman is the interviewer. She is wearing smart business clothes, holding some papers, and smiling nicely. The young man is the candidate. He is wearing a white shirt and looks a bit nervous but very polite. They are shaking hands over the desk. On the desk, there is a laptop, a notepad, and a cup of coffee. Behind them, there is a big window with some green plants. I think this is a very important moment for the young man, and he wants to get this job. It looks like a friendly interview.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 2 - Describe a picture

When was the last time you watched the news on television?
questions.sampleAnswer: The last time I watched the news on television was last night. I was having dinner with my family in the living room. We always turn on the TV at seven o'clock to watch the national news. We saw some interesting reports about the weather and a new park in our city. It is a good way for us to talk and share our day together.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 2 - Describe a picture

Do you prefer to get your news from television or from the internet? Why?
questions.sampleAnswer: I prefer to get my news from the internet. It is very fast and easy to use. I can read the news on my smartphone anywhere and anytime, like when I am waiting for the bus. Television news only starts at a specific time, so it is not very convenient. Also, the internet has many different websites, so I can choose what I want to read.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 3 - Compare two pictures

Compare these two pictures.
questions.sampleAnswer: In the first picture, I can see a young person studying with printed books. He is sitting at a wooden desk and writing notes with a pen. It looks very quiet and traditional. In the second picture, there is another young person learning on a computer. She is wearing headphones and looking at a laptop screen. This looks very modern and digital. Both ways of learning are good. Using paper books is great because you can focus easily and there are no screen distractions. However, learning on a computer is also good because you can find a lot of information on the internet. In my opinion, books are better for deep reading, but computers are faster for research. I think both methods are very useful for students today.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 3 - Compare two pictures

Which way of learning do you prefer: using books or using a computer? Why?
questions.sampleAnswer: Personally, I prefer learning with a computer. I like it because it is very fast and convenient. I can search for new words and find information easily on the internet. Also, I can watch educational videos on YouTube, which helps me understand difficult lessons better. Studying with books is nice, but using a computer is more exciting and saves me a lot of time.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 3 - Compare two pictures

Why do you think more and more people are learning on computers these days?
questions.sampleAnswer: I think more people learn on computers because it is very convenient. You can study from home, so you do not need to travel to school. Also, there are many free courses and lessons online. It is very cheap and easy to start learning. Finally, computers have colorful videos and games, which make learning fun for everyone, especially young children.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 4 - Discuss an abstract topic

Describe a time when you had to do something in a hurry, or when you were in a rush. What was the situation, when did it happen, why did you have to rush, and how did you feel?
questions.sampleAnswer:
One time I was in a real hurry was last month, on a Monday morning. I had an important English class at 8 o’clock, and I also had to give a short talk in front of my classmates. I woke up late because my phone alarm did not ring. When I looked at the time, it was already 7:30. I got dressed quickly, did not eat breakfast, and ran to the bus stop. Then I saw that I had left my notes at home, so I had to run back and get them. I felt very worried and tired, but I arrived at school just before the class started. After that, I felt happy and relieved.

I think many people are always in a hurry these days because they have too much work and many things to do. They also spend a lot of time on their phones. In my opinion, it is better to plan time carefully because it helps me stay calm and finish important things. However, I need some free time to relax.
